I will analyze the TSN network and calculate the worst-case delay (WCD) for each flow using Cyclic Queuing and Forwarding (CQF).

## CQF Parameters and Methodology

**CQF Mechanism:**
- Two queues alternate every cycle: Queue 7 (odd cycles) and Queue 6 (even cycles)
- Cycle duration: 50 µs
- Hypercycle: LCM of all flow periods divided by cycle duration

**Key Parameters:**
- Bandwidth: 100 Mbps = 100,000,000 bps
- Propagation delay per link: 1 µs
- Switching delay: 1 µs
- Time synchronization error: 1 µs
- Cut-through switching is used

**WCD Equation for CQF:**
WCD = Offset_start + Transmission_delay_first_hop + (num_hops - 1) × (Cycle_duration + Switching_delay + Propagation_delay) + Transmission_delay_last_hop + Propagation_delay_last_hop + Time_sync_error

Where:
- Transmission_delay = (Frame_size_bits) / Bandwidth
- Frame_size = Payload + Ethernet_overhead (38 bytes: 14 Eth header + 4 FCS + 20 IFG/Preamble)
- num_hops = number of switch-to-switch or switch-to-end-system hops

**Hypercycle Calculation:**
Flow periods: 9375, 12500, 15000, 25000, 37500, 62500, 75000, 125000, 187500, 375000 µs
LCM = 375000 µs
Hypercycle = 375000 / 50 = 7500 cycles

## CQF Parameters and Methodology

**CQF Mechanism:**
- Two queues alternate every cycle: Queue 7 (odd cycles) and Queue 6 (even cycles)
- Cycle duration: 50 µs
- Hypercycle: LCM of all flow periods divided by cycle duration

**Parameters:**
- Bandwidth: 100 Mbps = 100,000,000 bps
- Propagation delay per link: 1 µs
- Switching delay: 1 µs
- Time synchronization error: 1 µs
- Cut-through switching is used

**WCD Equation for CQF:**
WCD = Offset_source + Transmission_delay_source + (Hop_count × (Propagation_delay + Switching_delay)) + Max_queue_delay + Synchronization_error

Where:
- Offset_source = 0 (given)
- Transmission_delay = (Payload_bytes × 8) / Bandwidth
- Max_queue_delay = Cycle_duration (worst case: packet arrives just after queue closes)
- Total hops include all switch traversals

I will analyze the TSN network and calculate the worst-case delay (WCD) for each flow using Cyclic Queuing and Forwarding (CQF).

## CQF Parameters and Methodology

**CQF Mechanism:**
- Two queues alternate every cycle: Queue 7 (odd cycles) and Queue 6 (even cycles)
- Cycle duration: 50 µs
- Hypercycle: LCM of all flow periods divided by cycle duration

**Parameters:**
- Bandwidth: 100 Mbps = 100,000,000 bps
- Propagation delay per link: 1 µs
- Switching delay: 1 µs
- Time synchronization error: 1 µs
- Cut-through switching is used

**WCD Equation for CQF:**
WCD = Offset_start + Transmission_delay_first_hop + (num_hops - 1) × (Cycle_duration + Switching_delay + Propagation_delay) + Transmission_delay_last_hop + Propagation_delay_last_hop + Time_sync_error

Where:
- Transmission_delay = (Frame_size_bits) / Bandwidth
- Frame_size = Payload + Ethernet_overhead (38 bytes: 14 MAC header + 4 FCS + 20 IFG/Preamble)
- num_hops = number of switch-to-switch or switch-to-end-system hops

**Hypercycle Calculation:**
Flow periods: 62500, 125000, 62500, 187500, 37500, 12500, 375000, 25000, 37500, 9375, 62500, 375000, 9375, 15000, 62500, 75000, 37500, 375000, 37500, 25000, 12500 µs
LCM of all periods = 375000 µs
Hypercycle = 375000 / 50 = 7500 cycles
